verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a government business-filing service, since such a service could ship command-line tooling for programmatic filings. Nothing in the evidence pack shows one. The documented surfaces are web portals (Ohio Business Gateway, OH|TAX) behind OHID sign-in, and the probes found 403 walls at robots.txt on ohiosos.gov and the bsportal filing portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
